title: Three more text models, with different reasons to pick each
summary:
Five new models, self-service account controls, and a round of fixes for model discovery and Pollen accounting.

Added `qwen3.8-27b` for multimodal input and structured output, `glm-5.3` for long-context reasoning, and Quest-accessible `nemotron-3.5-lightning` with tools and optional reasoning. The new models keep separate IDs from existing offerings.

Added `grok-tts` with 28 voices and MP3, WAV, or PCM output, plus `fish-audio-s2.1-pro` with MP3 and PCM output. Both use the existing speech endpoints. Regenerated audio docs also make additional voice presets easier to find.

Enter gained an Account page with profile details, a copyable Pollinations ID, and self-service deletion. The account-key response now identifies the app behind a BYOP-minted key. Quest rewards are keyed to GitHub identity so recreating an account cannot claim the same reward twice, and two community members gained community-model access.

daily.title: Qwen3.8 27B joins
daily.text: Use `qwen3.8-27b` with text, image, or video input, plus tools, reasoning controls, and structured output. It has a 262,144-token context window and is paid-only. [Browse the model](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=qwen3.8-27b).

daily.title: GLM-5.3 joins
daily.text: Use `glm-5.3` for text tasks with tools, reasoning, and a 1,048,576-token context window. It is paid-only and separate from the existing `glm` service. [Browse the model](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=glm-5.3).

daily.title: Nemotron 3.5 Lightning joins
daily.text: Try Quest-accessible `nemotron-3.5-lightning` with tools, optional reasoning, and a 262,144-token context window. It is separate from the existing `nemotron` model. [Browse the model](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=nemotron-3.5-lightning).

daily.title: Grok text-to-speech
daily.text: Generate speech with `grok-tts` using 28 built-in voices and MP3, WAV, or PCM output through the existing speech endpoints. The model is paid-only. [Browse the model](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=grok-tts).

daily.title: Fish Audio S2.1 Pro
daily.text: Generate speech with paid-only `fish-audio-s2.1-pro` through the existing speech endpoints, with MP3 or PCM output. [Browse the model](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=fish-audio-s2.1-pro).

daily.title: Account settings arrive
daily.text: View your GitHub profile details, copy your Pollinations ID, or delete your account from the new Account page. Deletion requires a recently created session.

daily.title: BYOP keys identify apps
daily.text: `GET /account/key` now returns a `byopApp` object for BYOP-minted keys, including the app’s display name when available and its `clientKeyId`. It replaces the flat `byopClientKeyId` field.

daily.title: More ways to sort models
daily.text: Sort Enter’s model catalog by Oldest, Name Z–A, or Publisher Z–A. Pricing is also easier to compare across mobile and desktop layouts. [Browse models](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models).
